entry.content:
4.0.365.0

4.0.365.0 (2026-11-06 19:40 UTC)

  • Athena (4.0.101.0)
    • Added support for Athena System Tables which writes Athena usage data to AWS S3 managed tables in Apache Iceberg format. Adds CreateSystemTableConfiguration, UpdateSystemTableConfiguration, DeleteSystemTableConfiguration, GetSystemTableConfiguration, and ListSystemTableStatuses.
  • AutoScaling (4.0.106.0)
    • Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling now lets you exclude managed resources from describe API responses using the new optional IncludeManagedResources parameter. Set this parameter to false to exclude managed resources from the response. By default, managed resources are included.
  • BedrockAgent (4.0.106.0)
    • Add support for configuring searchability for metadata fields via UpdateKnowledgeBase request for Managed Knowledge Base. Once a field is marked as searchable it can be queried via query text and is factored into Managed Knowledge Base's ranking algorithm.
  • CloudFront (4.0.103.6)
    • CloudFront is now generated from its Smithy model. There are no changes to the public API.
  • CloudSearchDomain (4.0.100.24)
    • Replaced legacy BCL preprocessor guards in hand-written code with NETFRAMEWORK. There are no changes to the public API.
  • Connect (4.0.131.0)
    • Rules in Amazon Connect now support ending email contacts associated to a case based on case events.
  • ConnectCases (4.0.101.0)
    • Amazon Connect Cases adds two Bulk Case Actions operations. BatchCreateRelatedItem adds a Comment-type related item to up to 100 cases per request, BatchUpdateCase updates fields (title, status, customer ID, custom) on up to 100 cases. Same domain, per-case success and failure results returned.
  • DataZone (4.0.112.0)
    • Adds support for updating OAuth 2.0 connection settings with UpdateConnection.
  • EKSAuth (4.0.102.0)
    • Added workloadIdentityProviderArn to the AssumeRoleForPodIdentity API response.
  • Glue (4.0.118.0)
    • Adds support for user-defined functions governed by AWS Lake Formation.
  • Lightsail (4.0.107.0)
    • Marking fields as sensitive in GetInstanceAccessDetails, CreateKeyPair, DownloadDefaultKeyPair, CreateBucketAccessKey, CreateContainerServiceRegistryLogin, and GetRelationalDatabase responses.
  • MediaConvert (4.0.107.0)
    • Smart subtitling uses AWS Elemental Inference to generate captions from your content's audio, in embedded, burn-in, DVB-Sub, IMSC, SMI, SRT, teletext, TTML, or WebVTT outputs. Also fixes HEVC passthrough writing an incomplete codecs string to DASH and HLS manifests.
  • RAM (4.0.101.0)
    • Adds support for using managed permission template parameters, discovering shared customer-managed permissions, and managing customer-managed permission deprecation.
  • Route53 (4.0.100.24)
    • Route53 is now generated from its Smithy model. There are no changes to the public API.
  • S3Control (4.0.101.12)
    • S3Control is now generated from its Smithy model. There are no changes to the public API.
  • SecurityToken (4.0.101.10)
    • Replaced legacy NETSTANDARD preprocessor guards in hand-written code with !NETFRAMEWORK. There are no changes to the public API.
  • SimpleDB (4.0.100.24)
    • SimpleDB is now generated from its Smithy model.
    • Added paginators for the ListDomains and Select operations.
  • SimpleNotificationService (4.0.100.25)
    • Flattened the hand-written platform-specific folders into the Custom folder. There are no changes to the public API.
  • SimpleSystemsManagement (4.0.105.0)
    • AWS Systems Manager now provides two new APIs - RegisterDefaultHostManagementConfiguration and DeregisterDefaultHostManagementConfiguration - along with a new DefaultHostManagementConfiguration CloudFormation resource type.
  • Core 4.0.102.19
    • Updating partitions.json file.
    • All service and extension packages updated to require new Core

Azure.Storage.Files.DataLake_12.29.0-beta.1

12.29.0-beta.1 (2026-11-05)

Features Added

  • Added support for Session Authentication for TokenCredential-authenticated clients using GET Blob operations. This is currently disabled by default and can be enabled via DataLakeClientOptions.SessionOptions.SessionMode.
  • Added support for locality-aware downloads for DataLakeFileClient.ReadTo, DataLakeFileClient.ReadToAsync, DataLakeFileClient.OpenRead, and DataLakeFileClient.OpenReadAsync operations. This is currently disabled by default and can be enabled via DataLakeFileReadToOptions.LayoutAwareRouting and DataLakeOpenReadOptions.LayoutAwareRouting.
  • Added support for scheduling file deletion with DataLakeFileClient.Upload and UploadAsync.

Breaking Changes

  • Changed the default value of StorageTransferOptions.InitialTransferSize used by partitioned uploads and downloads when it is not set by the caller. It now matches the default size of subsequent chunks instead of 256 MB:
    • Downloads (DataLakeFileClient.ReadTo/ReadToAsync): the first range request now defaults to 4 MB, the same as subsequent ranges. Previously, it was 256 MB when no transfer checksum was used.
    • Uploads (DataLakeFileClient.Upload/UploadAsync): a file is now uploaded in a single Append and Flush only if its content is smaller than the default block size (4 MB, or 8 MB for content of 100 MB or more). Previously, content smaller than 256 MB was uploaded in a single append.
    • This means uploads and downloads may be partitioned more often, leading to more requests.
    • Explicitly set InitialTransferSize and MaximumTransferSize values are still respected. To restore the previous behavior, set StorageTransferOptions.InitialTransferSize to 256 MB.

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed SAS timestamp handling for non-UTC DateTimeOffset values. SAS times are now normalized to UTC before formatting/signing, preventing unintended validity windows in st/se (Start Time, Expiry Time) and related delegation key fields. Affected APIs include:
    • DataLakeFileSystemClient.GenerateSasUri(...)
    • DataLakeFileSystemClient.GenerateUserDelegationSasUri(...)
    • DataLakePathClient.GenerateSasUri(...)
    • DataLakePathClient.GenerateUserDelegationSasUri(...)

Azure.Storage.Blobs_12.31.0-beta.1

12.31.0-beta.1 (2026-11-05)

Features Added

  • Added support for Session Authentication for TokenCredential-authenticated clients using GET Blob operations. This is currently disabled by default and can be enabled via BlobClientOptions.SessionOptions.SessionMode.
  • Changed the default value of GetBlobsOptions.ResponseFormat and GetBlobsByHierarchyOptions.ResponseFormat to StorageResponseFormat.Arrow. The default value was previously StorageResponseFormat.Xml. This change will improve performance and modify the response format of the GetBlobs and GetBlobsByHierarchy APIs when the caller does not explicitly set the response format. Callers that require XML responses should explicitly set the response format to StorageResponseFormat.Xml.
  • Added support for locality-aware downloads for BlobBaseClient.DownloadTo, BlobBaseClient.DownloadToAsync, BlobBaseClient.OpenRead, and BlobBaseClient.OpenReadAsync operations. This is currently disabled by default and can be enabled via BlobDownloadToOptions.LayoutAwareRouting and BlobOpenReadOptions.LayoutAwareRouting.

Breaking Changes

  • Changed the default value of StorageTransferOptions.InitialTransferSize used by partitioned uploads and downloads when it is not set by the caller. It now matches the default size of subsequent chunks instead of 256 MB:
    • Downloads (BlobBaseClient.DownloadTo/DownloadToAsync): the first range request now defaults to 4 MB, the same as subsequent ranges. Previously, it was 256 MB when no transfer checksum was used.
    • Uploads (BlobClient.Upload/UploadAsync, BlockBlobClient.Upload/UploadAsync): a blob is now uploaded in a single Put Blob request only if its content is smaller than the default block size (4 MB, or 8 MB for content of 100 MB or more). Previously, content smaller than 256 MB was uploaded in a single request.
    • This means uploads and downloads may be partitioned more often, leading to more requests.
    • Explicitly set InitialTransferSize and MaximumTransferSize values are still respected. To restore the previous behavior, set StorageTransferOptions.InitialTransferSize to 256 MB.

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed client-side encryption v1 decryption of ranged downloads so the 16-byte IV is fully read even when the ciphertext stream returns short reads, and a truncated IV now fails instead of silently corrupting plaintext.
  • Fixed SAS timestamp handling for non-UTC DateTimeOffset values. SAS times are now normalized to UTC before formatting/signing, preventing unintended validity windows in st/se (Start Time, Expiry Time) and related delegation key fields. Affected APIs include:
    • BlobBaseClient.GenerateSasUri(...)
    • BlobBaseClient.GenerateUserDelegationSasUri(...)
    • BlobContainerClient.GenerateSasUri(...)
    • BlobContainerClient.GenerateUserDelegationSasUri(...)
    • BlobServiceClient.GenerateAccountSasUri(...)

entry.title: open-telemetry/opentelemetry-dotnet-contrib - Releases - 2026-11-06
entry.content:
Extensions.Enrichment.AspNetCore-1.20.2-beta.1

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Extensions.Enrichment.AspNetCore v1.20.2-beta.1

    No notable changes.

    See CHANGELOG for details.

Instrumentation.AspNetCore-1.20.2

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.AspNetCore v1.20.2

    • Fixed http.route and the span name being set to text taken from the request
      path when the page route value is populated from a route parameter of an
      endpoint that has no route template (such as MapFallbackToController,
      MapDynamicControllerRoute or IRouter-based routing). The page route value
      is now only used as a fallback for Razor Pages endpoints with an empty route
      template.
      (#5929)

    • Routes longer than 256 characters are no longer added to the cache of span
      display names, so that a route derived from the request cannot cause an
      arbitrary amount of memory to be retained for the lifetime of the process.
      (#5929)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

Instrumentation.SqlClient-1.20.2

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.SqlClient v1.20.2

    • Fixed db.query.summary so that a delimited identifier, such as [Orders] or
      [dbo].[Orders], is captured wherever an undelimited identifier would be
      (for example after INSERT INTO, EXEC, CREATE TABLE or a JOIN which
      follows an ON clause), instead of only in a FROM clause.
      (#5816)

    • Fixed a bracketed identifier which contains quotes and a comment marker, such
      as [Orders''--], being parsed as SQL, which truncated the sanitized query
      text and left a literal after it unsanitized if it was on a later line.
      (#5827)

    • Fixed the time taken to sanitize a statement when it contains many IN ( lists
      which are not terminated.
      (#5827)

    • Fixed literals in a list of values in brackets (e.g. ['a', 'b']) being left
      unsanitized if the list starts with a string in dollar quotes, a string with a
      prefix, a number or a comment, or has a comment which contains a closing
      bracket.
      (#5827)

    • Updated Semantic Conventions version to 1.45.0.
      (#5833)

    • Fixed db.query.summary so that a multi-part name which mixes undelimited
      and delimited parts, such as dbo.[Orders], or which has whitespace around
      a period, such as dbo . Orders or [dbo] . [Orders], is captured whole,
      and so that a trailing period is no longer left in the summary when no
      further part of the name follows it. As the summary is used to name the
      span, the names of affected spans change.
      (#5822)

    • Fixed db.query.summary so that the table name is included for a
      TRUNCATE statement, with or without TABLE, for example
      TRUNCATE TABLE Orders rather than TRUNCATE TABLE.
      (#5822)

    • Fixed the cache of sanitized SQL statements retaining statements of any
      length for the lifetime of the process. Statements longer than 8192
      characters are no longer cached.
      (#5869)

    • The attributes of the db.client.operation.duration metric are no longer
      affected by tags set on the command's activity by processors or by
      EnrichWithSqlCommand.
      (#5865)

    • Fixed a memory leak on .NET Framework when a command executed asynchronously
      fails before it is sent. Upgrade to apply the fix.
      (#5872)

    • Fixed the activity of a command executed asynchronously (for example with
      ExecuteNonQueryAsync()) being left as Activity.Current after the command
      completed, which made every later command executed by the same method a child
      of it and retained them all for as long as the method ran. The activity of a
      command is no longer Activity.Current while the command executes or while
      Filter and EnrichWithSqlCommand run, so use the activity argument of
      EnrichWithSqlCommand instead.
      (#5866)

    • Fixed a memory leak on .NET when a command executed asynchronously is
      started with a CancellationToken that is already cancelled and has no
      activity.
      (#5924)

    • Fixed redaction of login and user names in additional CREATE, ALTER and
      DROP statement positions, including references after FOR LOGIN and
      WITH NAME =, and names containing combining marks.
      (#5905)

    • Fixed db.query.summary for identifiers beginning with SQL keywords and
      login or user statements in multi-statement commands.
      (#5905)

    • Fixed query sanitization after bracketed identifiers containing apostrophes
      and after dollar signs in identifiers, temporary table names and variables.
      (#5905)

    • Fixed query sanitization of hexadecimal literals preceded by a unary plus.
      (#5905)

    • Fixed literals being left unsanitized in malformed SQL Server queries when
      escaped brackets extend an identifier beyond its 128-character limit.
      (#5905)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

Instrumentation.EntityFrameworkCore-1.20.2-beta.1

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.EntityFrameworkCore v1.20.2-beta.1

    • Fixed db.query.summary so that a delimited identifier, such as [Orders] or
      [dbo].[Orders], is captured wherever an undelimited identifier would be
      (for example after INSERT INTO, EXEC, CREATE TABLE or a JOIN which
      follows an ON clause), instead of only in a FROM clause.

    • Fixed suppressed or unsampled nested commands enriching or stopping an outer

      (#5821)

    • Fixed a bracketed identifier which contains quotes and a comment marker, such

      text and left a literal after it unsanitized if it was on a later line.
      (#5827)

    • Fixed the time taken to sanitize a statement when it contains many IN ( lists
      which are not terminated.
      (#5827)

    • Fixed literals in a list of values in brackets (e.g. ['a', 'b']) being left
      unsanitized if the list starts with a string in dollar quotes, a string with a
      prefix, a number or a comment, or has a comment which contains a closing
      bracket.
      (#5827)

    • Updated the Semantic Conventions version used for the database semantic
      conventions emitted when OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN includes database
      or database/dup to 1.45.0.
      (#5833)

    • Fixed db.query.summary so that a multi-part name which mixes undelimited
      and delimited parts, such as dbo.[Orders], or which has whitespace around
      a period, such as dbo . Orders or [dbo] . [Orders], is captured whole,
      and so that a trailing period is no longer left in the summary when no
      further part of the name follows it. As the summary is used to name the
      span, the names of affected spans change.
      (#5822)

    • Fixed db.query.summary so that the table name is included for a
      TRUNCATE statement, with or without TABLE, for example
      TRUNCATE TABLE Orders rather than TRUNCATE TABLE.
      (#5822)

    • Fixed the cache of sanitized SQL statements retaining statements of any
      length for the lifetime of the process. Statements longer than 8192
      characters are no longer cached.
      (#5869)

    • Fixed provider-specific query sanitization for Cloud Spanner (GoogleSQL)
      literals, comments and escaped backtick identifiers, Firebird q'...'
      literals using whitespace or apostrophe delimiters, SQL Server and SQLite
      bracketed identifiers, and databases whose block comments do not nest.
      (#5905)

    • Fixed redaction of login and user names in additional CREATE, ALTER and
      DROP statement positions, MySQL account lists and RENAME USER
      statements, including additional Unicode account-name forms and PostgreSQL
      Unicode-escaped identifiers and their UESCAPE clauses.
      (#5905)

    • Fixed redaction of Oracle passwords in IDENTIFIED BY and REPLACE
      clauses, including unquoted and double-quoted values and non-ASCII
      characters, and Teradata PASSWORD = values.
      (#5905)

    • Fixed db.query.summary for identifiers beginning with SQL keywords and
      login or user statements in multi-statement commands.
      (#5905)

    • Fixed PostgreSQL query sanitization for dollar signs in identifiers,
      including combining marks and supplementary characters before digits,
      and dollar-quoted literals with non-ASCII tags.
      (#5905)

    • Fixed query sanitization so that dollar-prefixed identifiers and parameters
      in MySQL, SQL Server and SQLite, and Oracle conditional compilation
      directives, are not mistaken for dollar-quoted literals.
      (#5905)

    • Fixed query sanitization of PostgreSQL binary/octal literals and digit
      separators, MySQL binary literals, SQLite digit separators, Oracle
      floating-point suffixes, and hexadecimal literals with supported unary
      operators.
      (#5905)

    • Fixed literals being left unsanitized in malformed SQL Server queries when
      escaped brackets extend an identifier beyond its 128-character limit.
      (#5905)

    • Fixed MySQL and MariaDB query sanitization so that adjacent minus signs
      are not mistaken for a comment without following whitespace, and a lone
      carriage return does not end a line comment.
      (#5905)

    • Fixed literals inside MySQL and MariaDB executable comments being left
      unsanitized. The remainder of a query after /*! or /*M! is now omitted
      because its boundary depends on the server version.
      (#5905)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

Extensions.Enrichment.Http-1.20.2-beta.1

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Extensions.Enrichment.Http v1.20.2-beta.1

    No notable changes.

    See CHANGELOG for details.

Extensions-1.20.1-beta.2

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Extensions v1.20.1-beta.2

    • Breaking Change BaggageActivityProcessor now adds baggage as tags when
      the activity ends instead of when it starts, and no longer replaces tags
      which are already present on the activity. Baggage tags are therefore not
      present while the activity is running. To have them exported, call
      AddBaggageActivityProcessor before adding the exporter.
      (#5857)

    See CHANGELOG for details.
